label: traveled or moved to
definition: Argument 1 traveled, relocated, returned or was transported to destination 2.
scope_notes: Direction toward the destination. Visits and historical movements qualify. Mere presence, residence, officeholding, or leaving/moving from the second argument alone does not. Unobserved modality is a corpus limitation.

facts.reason: The move-to-Sudan row explicitly supports movement toward Sudan; residence and leaving rows are separate facts.
Congress explicitly returns to Washington. The institution is used collectively for its members; this is ordinary travel metonymy.
Barnes Foundation explicitly moves to/into Philadelphia; the paths express the selected relocation relation, with temporal/modality details unavailable.
Clinton comes to, visits and flies to New York; these independently support the destination relation.
Soviet Jews explicitly move, emigrate and arrive in Israel.
